metadata.description: Name of the Container App and prefix of the other resources: lowercase letters and digits, starting with a letter.
Azure region. Defaults to the resource group's.
Annotide release to run (the image tag on ghcr.io/annotide).
Licence key from annotide.com. Empty: Community (up to three active users).
Generated on every deployment; re-running the template sets a new one on server and app together.

variables.$fxv#1:
SELECT
  (SELECT count(*) FROM job WHERE status IN ('queued', 'running'))
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM outbox_event WHERE published_at IS NULL AND attempts < 10)
  + (SELECT count(*) FROM webhook_delivery WHERE status = 'pending' AND next_attempt_at <= CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
